source: scratch probe (probe-bg-idle.mjs): direct Agent SDK query() with streaming input, CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_SESSION_STATE_EVENTS=1, includePartialMessages, perTaskStopAffordance; same wrapper shape as the host captures (t = ms since start, message.content = SDK frame)
description: Real capture (2026-09-14, SDK 0.3.272 / CLI 2.1.272). Explicit run_in_background:true subagent (Bash sleep inside). NEW since CLI 2.1.269 ("headless sessions no longer report waiting-for-input while background agents are still running"): NO session_state_changed:idle after the lead turn result while the subagent is live, and no running/idle pair around the wake; the session stays running until the wake turn result, then a single idle. The settlement tracker must stay busy throughout and settle only at that final idle.
